[[File:MandalorianMarauder.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Mandalorian marauder]]
'''Mandalorian marauder''' was a title and position held by members of the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]]. These lethal [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] wore [[Neo-Crusader armor]] and wielded deadly [[dire vibroblade]]s, focusing on stealthy combat to engage and terrify their foes. Whether through skill or with the aid of a [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field generator]], Mandalorian marauders were often invisible to the targets they stalked, [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] lone targets with trained precision.

==Description==
Mandalorian marauders were specialized [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] within the ranks of the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]]. They focused upon stealth tactics, and preferred one-on-one engagements, [[Hunting/Legends|stalking]] and isolating targets they could then silently eliminate. Most Mandalorian marauders relied on their skill, alone, though some would occasionally make use of [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field generators]] to operate unseen even during the day.<ref name="KotORMinis">{{SWMiniCite|set=Knights of the Old Republic|pack=Mandalorian Marauder}}</ref>

==History==
The Mandalorian marauders were a part of the Mandalorian Neo-Crusader [[Army/Legends|army]],<ref name="KotORMinis" /> serving under [[Mandalore the Ultimate]] as he opposed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and attempted to conquer the known [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="KotORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Dispatched to hunt down and [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] singular targets, Mandalorian marauders earned a terrifying reputation. Their tradition as hunters lived on for millennia, and the later Mandalorians' affinity for working as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] was seen by some as the legacy of the marauders.<ref name="KotORMinis" />

==Equipment==
Mandalorian marauders were outfitted in [[Neo-Crusader armor|the armor]] of the Mandalorian Neo-Crusader faction, adorned with the [[red]] [[Color/Legends|color]] scheme<ref name="KotORMinis" /> assigned to Mandalorian [[Rally Master]]s.<ref name="KotORCG" /> Marauders were armed with dire vibroblades and [[Mandalorian heavy blaster|heavy blaster pistols]], and were equipped with a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Miniatures Preview 4">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/KOTORminispreview4|text=''Knights of the Old Republic'' Miniatures Preview 4}}</ref> Mandalorian marauders were also known to use stealth field generators to operate under a cloak of invisibility.<ref name="KotORMinis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mandalorian marauders first entered ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] with the release of the [[Knights of the Old Republic (Star Wars Miniatures)|''Knights of the Old Republic'']] line of ''[[Star Wars Miniatures]]''.
